title: pentacalia involuta
intro: Pentacalia involuta, commonly known as the Involuted Pentacalia, is a plant species native to the Andean region. It is a type of flowering plant, belonging to the Asteraceae family, known for its medicinal properties and traditional uses in folk medicine. Studies have shown that Pentacalia involuta possesses various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions, such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Pentacalia involuta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects.
